schedule.subtitle: Your weekly routine. Click an empty slot to add.

placeholder: This will be built in a later stage.

settings.scheduleHint: The ring on Today spans wake-up to bedtime. Record each day's actual times with the button, or click the times at the ring's ends.
settings.wipeHint: Delete every activity, record, plan and journal entry
settings.wipeBody: Every activity, record, plan and journal entry will be deleted. A JSON backup is saved to your Downloads folder first; you can restore it with Import….

overlay.dragHint: Drag to move, then click Done in Settings

activities.cannotDelete: {{name}} has {{count}} records, so it can't be deleted. Archive it if you no longer use it.
activities.confirmDelete: Delete {{name}}? Its plans are deleted too. This can't be undone.
activities.confirmDeleteWithSubs: Delete {{name}} and its {{count}} sub-activities? Their plans are deleted too. This can't be undone.

plan.onceHint: Just this day. Pick weekdays to repeat every week.
plan.seriesHint: Repeats weekly: changes and deletion apply to the whole series.
plan.confirmDeleteSeries: Delete this weekly plan? The whole series is deleted.
plan.autoLogHint: Repeats weekly. When it ends and you haven't recorded anything then, a record is added for you. Delete that record to mark it as skipped.
plan.untilBeforeStart: The end date is before the start

errors.overlap: This overlaps another record. Adjust that one first.
errors.in_use: This activity has records, so it can only be archived.
errors.not_found: This item no longer exists; it may have been deleted.

record.confirmDelete: Delete the {{name}} record from {{range}}? This can't be undone.

day.editWakeHint: Changes this day only; Settings holds the default.
day.editSleepHint: A time before the wake-up counts as after midnight. Changes this day only.

schedule.empty: No weekly routine yet. Click any slot above to add one, like a class.

sync.title: Sync
sync.notConfiguredHint: This build has no sync server, so everything stays on this computer. See supabase/README.md to turn sync on.
sync.signedOutHint: Records on this device are merged into the account.
sync.signedInHint: Signing out keeps everything on this device.
sync.signedOutNote: Signed out. Your records stay on this device.
sync.checkEmail: Check {{email}} for a confirmation link, then sign in here.
sync.switchBody: This device last synced with {{previous}}. Its records will be merged into {{next}}. Nothing is deleted.

error.not_configured: This build has no sync server.
error.network: Can't reach the sync server. Hope will keep trying.
error.email_not_confirmed: Confirm your email first: check your inbox for the link.
error.user_already_exists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
error.session_expired: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again.
error.server: The sync server reported an error: {{message}}
error.decode: Unexpected answer from the sync server: {{message}}
